Execute a sequence of multiple actions (click, type, click) and verify all succeed with correct indices

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.*;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
        var engineConfig = MAPPER.readValue("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"}}", CrawlConfig.class);
        var engine = io.xberg.crawlberg.Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig);
        String url = "https://example.com";
        var result = Crawlberg.interact(engine, url, java.util.Arrays.asList(JsonUtil.fromJson("{\"selector\":\"#open\",\"type\":\"click\"}", PageAction.class), JsonUtil.fromJson("{\"selector\":\"#field\",\"text\":\"test_data\",\"type\":\"type\"}", PageAction.class), JsonUtil.fromJson("{\"selector\":\"#submit\",\"type\":\"click\"}", PageAction.class)));
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
